messages:
lee: Quick proposal to tighten postmortem follow-ups — short pilot.

taylor: paste the plan here please.

lee: plan:
Day0: IC ack + short debrief
Day1-3: assign owners, open tracker tasks
Day7: owners update in weekly sync
Day10: mid-run health check for longer work
Day14: determine if issue is recurring
Day21: verification + QA before close
Day30+: include flagged items in monthly recurrence review

jamal: replace Google sheet with a tracked project (Linear/Jira). Template fields: incident, owner, ETA, verification steps, status, recurring_tag.
rachel: +1. also require owner & ETA when creating the task.

ops-bot: Action CREATED REM-3042 by lee assigned to jamal due 2081235000

jamal: i'll build the project and template this week. who will own comms format?

taylor: propose comms format for updates: "Impact | Next step | Owner ETA". Immediate ack: 1-line impact + team. Post-incident: 3hr summary to #incidents.

rachel: pin the 15-min update template in the incident channel so it's copyable.

lee: IC rotation: 2-week windows, opt-in roster, primary + backup. no mid-incident handoffs unless agreed.

jamal: ops suggestion: weekly 30-min follow-up for actions older than 7 days; owners must attend as needed.

taylor: pilot: run 4 sprints, track metrics: time-to-owner, time-to-close, recurrence. owners for pilot: lee (docs), jamal (tracker), rachel (comms), taylor (IC roster).

ops-bot: Calendar "PM Follow-up Pilot" created starting 2081235100 attendees: lee,jamal,rachel,taylor

lee: i'll update the handbook with timeline + checklist and link back here. flag concerns in 24h.

rachel: no objections.

taylor: sounds good :thumbsup:

jamal: will seed a few template tasks tonight.
